gate_type: ACCELERATED IMPLEMENTATION GATE — Runtime Context + Provenance v2 (G2)
objective: Implement the smallest reusable, immutable, mechanism-neutral runtime/run context + provenance v2 foundation that later gates attach to executable Simulation Scopes and shared outputs, WITHOUT duplicating run identity, collapsing VF structural identity with PIM semantic identity, or changing domain execution semantics. Reconcile existing discrete.RunContext (no duplicate authority); thread provenance additively into shared telemetry/output seam; origin_kind=simulation with only frozen simulation data_status; no fabricated PIM canonical id; preserve discrete/ASSY backward compatibility.
explicit_non_objectives: No G4 Composition Graph / Coordinator / Typed Ports
No G7 scenario/run control commands or replay orchestration
No G9 PIM semantic binding / canonical-id resolver / artifact validation
forbidden_actions: Implement G3+ (observation/event/alarm redesign, coordinator/ports, ASSY federation, UI, run-control/replay, PIM binding, SH-WTP runtime)
Relabel simulation output as plant measured/ground_truth
Introduce a second authoritative run-identity model
stop_conditions: Implementing a generic runtime context requires changing G1 structural identity semantics
Two existing run-context models cannot be reconciled without a breaking public-contract decision
Correct provenance threading requires redefining Observation/Event/Alarm semantics (G3)
Semantic contract pins cannot be represented without implementing PIM binding/validation (G9)
Protocol propagation requires a breaking external schema not already authorized
Preserving ASSY/discrete behavior requires domain runtime rewrite
Provenance fields would have to fabricate canonical PIM identity or relabel simulation as plant measurement

acceptance_criteria.description: One generic mechanism-neutral runtime context/provenance seam exists
Existing discrete run context safely reconciled without duplicate authority
G1 workspace/scope structural identity carried without semantic collapse
Shared telemetry/output paths carry deterministic provenance additively
Simulation truth labels are fail-closed (origin_kind=simulation; only frozen data_status/fidelity)
Mandatory regressions pass or baseline anomalies honestly evidenced
Working tree clean and branch/head pushed
